Title: Create Forum Workflow in Forums Module
Description: Steps to create a new forum with specific name, title, description, and sidebar content.
- Navigate to the 'Forums' section by clicking the 'Forums' link.
- Click the 'Create forum' link on the list of forums page.
- Fill the 'Name' required field with the desired forum name.
- Fill the 'Title' required field with the desired forum title.
- Fill the 'Description' required field with the welcome text.
- Fill the 'Sidebar' required field with a markdown list of categories.
- Click the 'Create forum' button to submit the form.
- Confirm success by landing on the new forum URL (e.g., /f/Cyberpunk).
- Recorded workflow clarification (intent, not verified execution): Workflow clarification: verify the required field before proceeding to the next form field.
